scope: All generated normalized and semantic content files for Classes 5-10 and every subject
policy: Remove source export numbering prefixes from generated filenames. Preserve source directory hierarchy and original_content byte-for-byte.
directory_policy: Retain Class and Subject folder names and the Source Files subfolder where present; only generated filenames are standardized.
original_files_policy: Never rename, overwrite, or modify original_content files.
versioning: The normalized common-envelope representation uses .v2.json; semantic-node representation uses .semantic.json.
